caption: The video captures a barefoot dancer in an olive tank top and black flared pants standing with her back partly to the camera before a floor-to-ceiling mirror wall, her front-facing reflection tracking each move. Sage-green curtains drape the right wall and reappear in the glass. A ballet barre, potted plants, and light stands line the pale wood floor. At the start her right arm is extended outward to her side, then she raises it overhead while her legs spread wide. She bends her knees and lowers her torso, bringing the right hand beside her head with the elbow flared, her hair swinging as her upper body turns. This overhead-to-head arm cycle repeats several times over the bent legs. She then lifts and bends her right leg behind her, transitioning into a pose with that leg extended back, toe pointed, and both arms bent forward at chest height. For the remaining frames she holds this extended-leg, arms-forward position with only small adjustments, while turning her body to face more toward the right side of the room.
relations: Dancer's right arm moves from side to overhead, mirrored by her reflection, while legs spread wide.
She bends knees, lowers torso, and turns upper body, swinging hair as the arm cycles.
Right leg lifts behind her, extending with pointed toe, as both arms bend forward at chest.
Holding the extended-leg pose, she rotates her body toward the right side of the room.
